title: Echoo's Structures
description: Adds new structures to your worlds
body:
![Project Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebccd87391bf6350079803d9edadf89d210eb8e8.png)

A mod that adds new strucutres to your worlds!

Currently adds a new trading post structure that currently can be found around your world! More structures and overhauls of some vanilla structures are planned.

This project is in very early development still so feedback is greatly appreciated. Bugs can be reported on GitHub
